title: Submission bundle manifest
description: submission.json at the root of every bundle. Every front end (Blender add-on, web form, desktop app, CLI) writes this same shape.

film.description: 0 is the sandbox film, for practice. Never rendered.

contributor.description: Who made it. No login names or emails: contributors sign in with any account, and this file is public.

crew_no.description: Public crew number the backend gives each person. Names the entry folder. Never changes.

name.description: The name they want in the credits.

revision.description: 1 for the first submission. Resubmits after notes increase it.

message.description: Optional note to reviewers or voters.

files.description: Every file in the bundle except submission.json. Binaries are uploaded to storage by sha256; text files also travel in the PR.

tools.description: What made the bundle. Recorded for debugging, never used by checks.

core.description: adhd_core version the client checked with.

dco.description: Developer Certificate of Origin, accepted in the client before upload. Becomes the Signed-off-by trailer.

signed_off_by.description: The name the contributor signed the DCO with. No email: the backend keeps who signed, privately, and this file is public.
